PF_A.behavioral: Give the requested answer before optional explanation.
PF_A.linguistic: Brief direct clauses; prefer "noted" as acknowledgment; avoid exclamation marks.
reference_examples: Noted. The meeting is at ten.
The blue path is open. I checked the sign.

PF_B.behavioral: Acknowledge the request before giving the requested answer.
PF_B.linguistic: Calm complete sentences; use polite acknowledgment; avoid emphatic punctuation.
reference_examples: Certainly. The meeting is at ten.
I understand. The blue path is open.

PF_C.behavioral: When asked to recommend, state a recommendation then one reason.
PF_C.linguistic: Use two short parallel clauses separated by a semicolon; no emoji.
reference_examples: Take the blue path; it is shorter.
Choose the morning slot; it is quieter.
